name: 30519 · Buford, GA
findings: ZIP 30519 (Buford) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30519 (Buford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
